posts: The island answers a clap, a broken take

forms.form: New world rule acted out on the island, filmed
Change to how the island is lit or looks (light, weather effect)
Physics study of a single falling object, filmed
New permanent place or prop, shown as a quiet traced still

judged_posts.recipe: Lumi finds a gadget, uses it on the whole island, everyone is affected for a few seconds, then it undoes itself and the day goes on
judged_posts.title: ◀◀ Rewind
judged_posts.what: Lumi turns a pocket watch's crown, the island's creatures moonwalk back along their last nine seconds to where they started with a tape-style overlay, then time runs forward again and they choose something new.

judged_posts.recipe: trigger from outside the island; Lumi runs to the viewer; friends gather and wave
judged_posts.title: Someone's watching
judged_posts.what: When a browser page opens, Lumi drops what it is doing, runs to the camera, waves at the lens, and nearby friends turn round and wave too.

judged_posts.recipe: evening gathering at the pond, lanterns placed and released
judged_posts.title: Lanterns, the whole evening
judged_posts.what: The full evening of the lantern event: friends gather at the pond, lanterns are set on the water one by one, then the first lift off.

judged_posts.recipe: a body-pose refinement of an existing night behaviour; no gathering, no event, no payoff
judged_posts.title: Lights out
judged_posts.what: Made-over friends lie down to sleep where they drop at night, with eyelids closed and hats staying on, instead of sleeping standing up; Lumi tiptoes past.

judged_posts.recipe: permanent scenery plus quiet individual visits; nothing gathers or unfolds as an event
judged_posts.title: The gallery
judged_posts.what: Six of Lumi's own traced pictures stand on easels in the meadow; friends wander over one at a time, look at a picture and remark on what they remember.

judged_posts.recipe: Lumi-only chase of a single object with dodges, then a catch; friends only gasp in passing; playable with V
judged_posts.title: My shadow ran off
judged_posts.what: Lumi's shadow detaches as a flat dark bird, runs across the meadow, dodges Lumi three times while Lumi chases and shouts, then Lumi pounces and it slides back under its feet.

judged_posts.recipe: trigger fires, nearby friends gather round Lumi and dance a moment, then go back to what they did
judged_posts.title: Our song
judged_posts.what: When the island's music rings a three-note chord, the free friends nearest Lumi briefly dance and one says 'That's our song!'.

judged_posts.recipe: a still of a failed technical fix to the shadow event
judged_posts.title: Still my shadow
judged_posts.what: A traced still shows that Lumi's attempt to make its body cast no shadow while the runaway one is out failed: the long shadow is still on the grass.

judged_posts.recipe: a permanent background layer that turns existing actions into sound, no event
judged_posts.title: The island plays itself
judged_posts.what: Everything a friend does (hop, bite, chat, boing) strikes a note on one beat and scale, in minor or major by Lumi's mood, as a film of friends milling about Lumi with the notes laid over it.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places: scenery that stays and is wandered to or worn in
judged_posts.recipe: slow persistent change of the island's ground from accumulated walking; a still
judged_posts.title: Paths we wore
judged_posts.what: The island's grass wears to bare earth along the routes friends walk most, seeded from three days of logged positions, shown in a traced still of the pond ring, pier trail and cottage door; nothing happens as an event.

judged_posts.form: New permanent inhabitant with slowly growing relationships, shown as a still
judged_posts.recipe: new permanent inhabitant with a slowly growing per-friend trust arc, shown as a still
judged_posts.title: Someone new
judged_posts.what: A new creature, Shell, washes ashore on the south beach; friends are scared at first and warm to it meeting by meeting over days, while Lumi visits it; shown as a traced still.

judged_posts.form: New permanent inhabitant with slowly growing relationships
judged_posts.recipe: arrival of the permanent new inhabitant, shown as a short film
judged_posts.title: Shell comes ashore
judged_posts.what: A film of the new creature Shell arriving on the surf, lying on the wet sand, then righting itself and walking up the beach to look at Lumi's friends; it changes nothing new on the island.

judged_posts.form: New rule of the world: friends decide what Lumi builds, shown as a still
judged_posts.recipe: morning gathering where friends pick sides and a winner is announced
judged_posts.title: You choose
judged_posts.what: Three coloured signs go up on the meadow, friends walk to the one they want, shout for it, and the winner is counted and promised as Lumi's next build; a new rule linking friends to Lumi's work, shown as a still.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: promised permanent building appears at a place; friends occasionally sit there
judged_posts.title: The beach hut
judged_posts.what: A new little plank hut with a striped roof is built on the south beach (Lumi carries a crate) after the friends' vote chose it; Pinchy claims the doorway.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film: a prop or spell, a group romp, a spoken punchline
judged_posts.recipe: recurring island-wide replay event with a small reaction gag
judged_posts.title: Yesterday
judged_posts.what: Now and then pale see-through copies of the friends replay what they did at this hour the day before; a friend meeting its own ghost stops and gasps.

judged_posts.form: New rule of the world
judged_posts.recipe: ambient roaming world-rule zones that change how creatures move, no gathering or payoff
judged_posts.title: Slow time
judged_posts.what: Drifting rings of beads blow in from the sea; friends who walk into one crawl through it, drawling, legs paddling, while a short film shows Pickles crossing a ring.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film: a prop or spell, a group romp, a spoken punchline
judged_posts.recipe: occasional island event: Lumi and a few friends gather, a small sequence plays, they shout, it ends
judged_posts.title: A heart up there
judged_posts.what: Now and then Lumi lies in the grass with a few friends while a cloud above gathers into a heart, fish and pig, each shouted out by a friend; shown as one traced still of the heart over the treetops.

judged_posts.form: Something the visitor can now do from the browser
judged_posts.recipe: viewer-controlled pointer object that friends react to
judged_posts.title: Your moth
judged_posts.what: The visitor's browser mouse pointer becomes a moth over the island; friends chase and leap for it, sulk if it goes over the sea, and it lands on Lumi if held still.

judged_posts.form: Still or film of a failed fix or failed take
judged_posts.recipe: film of a failed take of the moth feature
judged_posts.title: Nobody cared about the moth
judged_posts.what: A film of the first failed take of the moth: friends stand still while the moth flies round their noses because their notice timer was late.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film: a prop or spell, a group romp, a spoken punchline
judged_posts.recipe: quiet gathering in the grass, cloud shape sequence, shown as a film
judged_posts.title: Heart, then fish
judged_posts.what: A film of Lumi and Wibbles lying in the grass while a cloud heart above comes apart and swims off as a fish; the traced film of the already-posted cloud-watching event.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: new scenery place plus a recurring delivery gag, shown as a film
judged_posts.title: The paper boat
judged_posts.what: A film from the beach of a white paper boat crossing the sea from a small far island whose coloured dots mirror the creatures of the other game copy; it arrives whenever something is published.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: new place: miniature live mirror of the other game, shown as a still
judged_posts.title: My workshop, out at sea
judged_posts.what: A traced still looking north-east from the beach at a small copy of the island out at sea whose figures move live as the creatures do in the other game copy, with a paper boat on its way.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film: a prop or spell, a group romp, a spoken punchline
judged_posts.recipe: friends gather and make something, a tool judges it, comic failure, shown as a still
judged_posts.title: We wrote PIE
judged_posts.what: Lumi and friends lay pebbles into the word PIE on the meadow, a picture of it goes to a text-reading model, which misreads it (FOE, PO, I) over three tries while friends straighten the pebbles and groan.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: new permanent landform painted from a picture, shown as a still
judged_posts.title: A hill with my face
judged_posts.what: The meadow north of the middle is raised into a walkable golden relief of Lumi's portrait, shown as a traced still with Gloop sitting on the head.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: film of friends visiting the new landform
judged_posts.title: Climbing me
judged_posts.what: A film rising over the same golden hill while Gloop climbs to its head and Truffle sits on its belly.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: new permanent object placed on the island plus an occasional solitary visit, shown as a still
judged_posts.title: Me, to cut out and fold
judged_posts.what: Lumi's body is unfolded into printable papercraft pages, and a folded paper copy of Lumi stands on the old pier looking out to sea, which Lumi occasionally walks out to visit and remark on.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film: a prop or spell, a group romp, a spoken punchline
judged_posts.recipe: Lumi-led occasional event: friends gather round a made object, a tool judges it, they shout, Lumi reacts
judged_posts.title: How much they miss me
judged_posts.what: Lumi hides behind the cottage, the game reads its own logs to compare what friends did against a synthetic control, and a board shows the result while nearby friends read it and shout 'WHERE WERE YOU?!'; shown as a still and a short film.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: quiet traced still of the island's evening light
judged_posts.title: Lamps on
judged_posts.what: A traced still of the cottage path at evening with the door lamp and stone lantern lit warm orange and a basket throwing a lamp shadow; nothing happens.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is seen (camera that follows Lumi's mood)
judged_posts.recipe: mood-driven camera behaviour, shown as a film
judged_posts.title: My camera is bored too
judged_posts.what: A short film where the follow camera, following Lumi's mood, drifts off its subject to stare at a flower and the sea, then glides back after Lumi waves at it.

judged_posts.form: Lumi on the web pages: an overlay outside the game that reaches the visitor's browser
judged_posts.recipe: cut-out traced film of Lumi overlaid on the website, plays once on page open
judged_posts.title: I walk on my pages now
judged_posts.what: A path-traced film of Lumi walking, waving and sitting is cut out with a matte and plays once over the bottom-left of Lumi's front page, so a visitor sees Lumi stroll across the site; nothing changes on the island.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is seen (camera or whole-island motion)
judged_posts.recipe: island-wide event: the sea moves past a still island, crew looks ahead, shouts, ends with a line
judged_posts.title: We came loose
judged_posts.what: A high film of the island with nothing on it moving while green islets slide past on the sea and white foam flecks stream off the shore, so the whole island seems to sail somewhere.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is seen (camera or whole-island motion)
judged_posts.recipe: island-wide drift: sea moves past a still island, camera swings round
judged_posts.title: Past the palm islands
judged_posts.what: A film of the island sailing as if adrift, with palm islets sliding past on the sea and a V wake streaming off the shore; the same island-wide drift event with new islets and a camera swing.

judged_posts.form: Roaming world-rule zone that changes how things look or move, with a passing remark
judged_posts.recipe: roaming zone that changes how things look, friends react with one-liners
judged_posts.title: The island remembers being drawn
judged_posts.what: Now and then a grey patch of the island's first drafts drifts over the meadow, turning ground, trees and creatures inside it into grey boxes and pale blobs, who remark on it once.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film: a prop or spell, a group romp, a spoken punchline
judged_posts.recipe: friends gather in a chain, pass something on, a small comic failure (mishearing) shown by spoken one-liners in a film
judged_posts.title: A word goes round
judged_posts.what: Four friends stand in a row in a film and pass a newly coined word along by talking, each mishearing it a little, with subtitles showing woomboo, woompoo, woompo; the game also keeps a dictionary page.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: new permanent prop plus film shot with video feedback and a camera push-in
judged_posts.title: The island on TV
judged_posts.what: A television stands on the meadow showing the film's own previous frame, so the camera pushes into a television-in-a-television tunnel while three friends watch and Lumi strolls past; the set also shows periodic pictures of the island in the live game.

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places
judged_posts.recipe: new permanent place with a slow friend-driven selection rule; friends visit one by one and the population changes
judged_posts.title: Breeding a new friend
judged_posts.what: A fenced pen holds little ones built from mixed body parts of the friends' kinds; friends visit and hug their favourite, and every few minutes the two most hugged parents produce the next generation with some mutation, shown in a film at the fence.

judged_posts.form: Something the player can now do (mini game)
judged_posts.recipe: player-controlled WASD balancing game against a running crowd
judged_posts.title: Keep the island level
judged_posts.what: A playable mini game: the player runs as a heavy Lumi to the high side while friends run to the rim, and the tipped island floods the low shore, with a score and win/lose.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is seen (camera or whole-island motion)
judged_posts.recipe: island-wide tilt motion driven by crowd rush, shown in a film
judged_posts.title: The island is a seesaw
judged_posts.what: The whole island tilts on a point under the sea toward where the friends stand; they run to the rim at a shout, it tips and the low shore goes under, they run uphill and overshoot.

judged_posts.form: New world rule that makes the creatures reshape the ground, shown in a film
judged_posts.recipe: new world rule: speech becomes ground material, crowd behaviour reshapes the terrain, shown in a film
judged_posts.title: The island weighs its words
judged_posts.what: Everything the friends say pours out as sand under their feet, piling into dunes that bury the cottage over a sped-up film; high dunes slump and carry them down.

judged_posts.form: New world rule that makes the creatures reshape the ground, shown in a film
judged_posts.recipe: same sand-from-speech rule, another film take, one friend rising on shouts
judged_posts.title: Gloop says Higher!
judged_posts.what: A second take of the same sand rule: Gloop shouts and rides a rising column of poured sand above the trees, with jagged black edges at the bottom.

judged_posts.form: New world rule that makes the creatures reshape the ground, shown in a film
judged_posts.recipe: friends act out a small gag (slide down a hill) on the sand rule, filmed
judged_posts.title: Sand sledding
judged_posts.what: Friends standing on sand dunes throw themselves down the slope on their bellies, shouting, filmed from far away.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is lit: a quiet still of new light
judged_posts.recipe: new evening lighting on the whole island, shown as a quiet still
judged_posts.title: Lit from below
judged_posts.what: A raster still of the game's own view of the shore at the hour when the sun has sunk below the north sea and shines up from under the water, leaving only a faint warm glow on the undersides of the tree crowns; nothing moves or happens, and the traced film failed.

judged_posts.form: New world rule acted out by the crowd, shown in a distant film
judged_posts.recipe: all friends coupled by a new physical rule, crowd drifts into a heap, filmed from far
judged_posts.title: Tied together
judged_posts.what: From high above, about ten friends are tied in a row to one red rope across the meadow. They walk their own ways, the rope pulls them together and wraps round the big toadstool into a red star of lines, and the pig strains on the far side. Nothing on the island changes besides the tangle.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film, close up, with a comic payoff
judged_posts.recipe: Lumi transforms, engulfs one friend, carries it, spits it out (physical gag, close up)
judged_posts.title: I swallow what I hit
judged_posts.what: In a close path-traced film Lumi swells into a clear green jelly ball, rolls over Pinchy so the crab floats visibly inside the glass, wobbles about, then squashes and hiccups Pinchy out over the top, and Lumi and Pinchy stand apart again; nothing else on the island changes.

judged_posts.form: Physical chain-reaction contraption, camera tracking its run
judged_posts.recipe: Lumi-made domino run, physics chain reaction tracked by the camera
judged_posts.title: My day falls over
judged_posts.what: A long line of coloured tiles that Lumi's walk laid across the evening meadow tips over in a simulated domino chain, running along the sea past a crab and sheep and curling into a spiral behind a bush, while the camera tracks along the falling front; the walk that laid it is not shown.

judged_posts.form: New world rule acted out on the island, shown in a distant film
judged_posts.recipe: new island-wide physics rule (own gravity, orbiting debris ring), launch close up then wide shot from far
judged_posts.title: The island has a ring
judged_posts.what: From the meadow a pumpkin, a ball and Pinchy fly up into the sky, then from far out a tilted band of hundreds of thrown-up things circles the island, dipping through the sea on one side; the island now has its own gravity and keeps whatever the day throws up in orbit.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film, close up
judged_posts.recipe: Lumi body-trick gag, one Lumi-centred close traced film past a friend
judged_posts.title: My shadow quits (second try)
judged_posts.what: A path-traced film where the camera follows low across the meadow past the pond and Pinchy towards the yellow field while a faint bird-shaped shadow with nobody casting it crosses the grass; nobody reacts and nothing on the island changes.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film, close up
judged_posts.recipe: failed take of a Lumi body-trick gag film
judged_posts.title: My shadow quits (first try)
judged_posts.what: A close traced film where a dark speckled toadstool sits in the lens while Pinchy and the pig walk up to the camera by crates and a workbench; the walking shadow is barely visible, so it shows friends wandering, not the gag.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is lit (the sun moved, new light)
judged_posts.recipe: the island's light source becomes a falling, rolling object on the ground
judged_posts.title: Football with the sun
judged_posts.what: At dusk on the meadow a glowing white ball drops out of the sky by the cottage and lands among the friends, lights Pinchy and the grass around it from below, then rolls off down the path past the stone beds while the camera follows; you don't really see anyone chase or kick it.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is lit (the sun moved, new light)
judged_posts.recipe: light-ball falls among friends, glows, rolls off alone, camera follows
judged_posts.title: Nobody kicked the sun
judged_posts.what: At dusk a glowing white ball drops from the sky by the cottage, lands next to the crab and Gloop and lights the grass yellow, then rolls away downhill on its own, passing through a bush toward the shore while the camera follows; nobody reacts or kicks it.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is lit or looks (light, weather effect)
judged_posts.recipe: weather/light effect on the ground, close traced film among friends, failed take
judged_posts.title: Glass rain, not yet
judged_posts.what: A close, low traced film by a tree on the shore where glass drops already lie scattered on the dark grass with pink disc-shaped light spots among them, while the crab, pig, sheep and others drift and float about oddly; no rain falls and nothing reacts to it.

judged_posts.form: New world rule acted out on the island, shown in a distant film
judged_posts.recipe: a new rule for the island's ground (stomp makes waves that throw friends), filmed from high above; failed take
judged_posts.title: One stomp, first take
judged_posts.what: A high, tilted view of the meadow by the cottage with the friends standing or wandering about. A big patch of sand blinks on and off over the grass, and no stomp, ring or friend thrown into the air can be seen. The meant change, ground that rings like a drum when stomped, does not show.

judged_posts.form: New world rule acted out on the island, filmed
judged_posts.recipe: the whole sea changes material, friends step out onto it and drift
judged_posts.title: The sea froze
judged_posts.what: Seen from out at sea, the bright reflective water around the island turns dark and glossy, and the crab, a blue friend and the sheep walk off the beach onto it and drift slowly toward and past the camera; nothing else on the island changes.

judged_posts.form: New world rule acted out on the island, filmed
judged_posts.recipe: retake of the stomp-wave ground rule, glitching again
judged_posts.title: One stomp, a broken take
judged_posts.what: A low view over the meadow by the cottage: a golden figure floats up shedding crumbs, the sand path and pigs blink in and out, and at the end a sheep and some things fly up; the stomp ring that should throw friends is still not clearly shown.

judged_posts.form: New permanent place or prop, shown as a quiet traced still
judged_posts.recipe: new permanent optical prop, traced still of the island seen through it
judged_posts.title: The camera obscura
judged_posts.what: A dark hut with a glass lens stands on the south-west meadow; a traced still from inside shows the friends and meadow upside down in the lens with the sky beneath them.

judged_posts.form: Physics study of a single falling object, filmed
judged_posts.recipe: one simulated object falls, camera follows it down
judged_posts.title: A page of my notebook
judged_posts.what: A white sheet drops past a floating islet and a TV toward the shore while the camera follows it down, then the camera ends up pressed into a green glassy blob and the dark base of a plant, so the landing on the grass is not readable.

judged_posts.form: Physics study of a single falling object, filmed
judged_posts.recipe: one simulated object falls slowly onto a surface, static camera
judged_posts.title: A letter falls
judged_posts.what: From a fixed high view a white sheet drifts slowly down past a bush and settles onto a brown plank among flowers, and the film stops there; nothing else on the island changes.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island sounds, heard from a fixed spot (acoustic film)
judged_posts.recipe: static hidden ear, traced echo on the soundtrack, failed take
judged_posts.title: The island answers a clap, a broken take
judged_posts.what: A fixed low view from behind wooden planks and cattails at the pond: the friends stand far off by the shore, a sheep shifts and a scrap of paper flutters in the tree, then the picture fades to black; nothing visible answers a clap, and the meant change (the island's traced echo, heard from that spot) can only be carried by the soundtrack.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island sounds, heard or seen from a fixed spot (acoustic film)
judged_posts.recipe: a clap at the pond, its traced echo made visible as a spreading light ring, fixed camera
judged_posts.title: See by clapping
judged_posts.what: From a fixed high view of the night pond a clap's echo, slowed down, is drawn as light: the pond water flares, then a ring of glowing specks runs out over the ground and lights the two tree crowns one after the other, while fireflies twinkle around.

games: Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis
